designationHistory.name: Des Lacs Migratory Waterfowl Refuge
designationHistory.indexText: Franklin D. Roosevelt signed Executive Order 7154-A reserving about 24,100 acres in Burke and Ward counties, North Dakota, along the Des Lacs River as a migratory waterfowl refuge.
designationHistory.note: CCP names EO 7154-A and the 1935 establishment; APP gives August 22, 1935. Renamed Des Lacs National Wildlife Refuge by Proclamation 2416 (July 25, 1940).

sources.name: The American Presidency Project (UC Santa Barbara), Executive Order 7154-A
